description: 1 page, 2 short invented sentences. The reading offered after listen-short.
format: Per page: `lines` = expected buildLines(page).map(l => l.text) in reading order; `spoken` = text to speak with DEFAULT_FILTERS; `spokenReadEverything` = text to speak with READ_EVERYTHING; `skipped` = what DEFAULT_FILTERS drop. Spoken text joins lines with single spaces, de-hyphenates "-" + lowercase line starts, and is normalized (ligatures expanded, soft hyphens removed, NBSP/thin space -> space).

lines: A baker opened her shutters before dawn. The street smelled of warm bread.
pages.spoken: A baker opened her shutters before dawn. The street smelled of warm bread.
pages.spokenReadEverything: A baker opened her shutters before dawn. The street smelled of warm bread.
